name: zeffect_reset
description: zEffect::Reset frees loaded effect templates and recycled runtime entries, destroys their effect nodes, reinitializes the runtime manager, and returns zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The native smoke reaches zEffect::Reset through zEffect::ShutdownAll; loadedTemplateTree cleanup is accepted from Binary Ninja evidence and the accepted zReader::FreeLoadedTree dependency.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x460330 frees loadedTemplateTree through zReader::FreeLoadedTree, frees the templates array, drains the freeList with zArchiveList::PopFrontPayload while destroying each entry's effectNode and freeing the entry, destroys the archive list, clears freeList and recycleCount, calls zEffect::Init, and returns zero.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x460330 has no warnings or tags and shows the same runtime-manager cleanup, free-list drain, zEffect::Init call, and zero return.
The dependency frontier for 0x460330 has no visible functional-verification blockers; zReader::FreeLoadedTree, zArchiveList helpers, zClass_Util::DestroyNodeRecursive, and zEffect::Init are accepted.
The native zeffect_shutdown_all_smoke reaches Reset through ShutdownAll and verifies templates, freeList, and recycleCount are cleared before the animation shutdown assertions.
